osting for the refrigeration chamber: When the environmental humidity is high or a large amount of damp items are placed in the cabinet, relying solely on the automatic defrosting function cannot fully defrost. At this point, it is necessary to activate the forced defrosting function. When the defrosting sensor senses that the temperature of the evaporator has reached -12 ℃ (default value of dFL parameter), it enters a forced defrosting state. At this time, the internal fan operates normally and the compressor stops; When either of the upper and lower temperature sensors is ≥ 5.6 ℃, or the sensor temperature is controlled to be ≥ 5 ℃ (dFH parameter adjustable), or the defrosting time is ≥ 20 Min, the defrosting state will exit and automatic normal operation will enter. During the forced defrosting period, "dF" is displayed alternately with the temperature inside the box, and the display window displays "dF" every 10 seconds for 10 seconds (if it is a display screen, the interface displays "forced defrosting"). The entry defrost temperature (dFL) and exit defrost temperature (dFH) are

every 10 seconds for 10 seconds (if it is a display screen, the interface displays "forced defrosting"). The entry defrost temperature (dFL) and exit defrost temperature (dFH) are factory/after -sales parameters that can be adjusted. Forced defrosting can be performed at most once within 12 adjacent hours, and will not be performed when the defrosting sensor fails. 6-2 Operating principle ① Control of condenser fan: When the mains power is normal, the condensing fan runs normally. ②Control of evaporator fan and light: when the door switch is turned on, the light in refrigerator compartment is on, and the inner fan stops; when the door is closed, the light is off, and the inner fan is on. ③ Control of compressor: Startup conditions: control sensor temperature Tc≥ set value (Ts)+ control temperature difference (r0) Shutdown condition: control sensor temperature T c≤ set value (Ts)- control temperature difference (r0) ④ Battery control: there is a battery switch on the device, which should be turned on before normal startup. B. “Lower temperature” indicator light (green): When the light is ON, the LED displays the temperature of the lower sensor. 。Simultaneously powered indicator LED lights display average value of the upper and lower temperature sensors. C. “Power supply” indicator light (green): When the light is on, the main power supply state is normal. When the light flickers, the main power is in failure state. D. “Alarm” indicator light (red): A flickering light indicates that there is a fault or abnormal condition. E. “Door opening” indicator light (red): When the door is opened, the light is normally on; when the door opening alarm is a

p: HAIER SERVİS MANUELLERİ\HYC-509(T, F, TF)-HC-220~240V-50HZ 60HZ-Service Manual.pdf
t: indicates that there is a fault or abnormal condition. E. “Door opening” indicator light (red): When the door is opened, the light is normally on; when the door opening alarm is activated, the light flickers; when the door is closed, the light is off. F. “Clogged condenser” indicator light (red): A flickering light indicates that the condenser is clogged and needs to be cleaned immediately. G. “Network” indicator light (green): When the light is on, the networking state is active. A flickering light means data communication is in process. H. “NFC” indicator light (green): When the light is on, it indicates that the NFC card reading board is connected; when the light is off, it indicates that the NFC recording board is not connected; when the light flickers, it indicates that the door lock is opened. Definition of LED buttons A. “Alarm test” button: It is used for alarm test. When pressed once, The buzzer beeps 3 times at 1 Hz .The alarm light flickers three times simultaneously. Compressor control Under normal working conditions, the start and stop of the compressor is controlled by the control sensor. The specific start - stop rules are as follows: Compressor start temperature: Set value (Ts)+r0 Compressor stop temperature: Set value (Ts) - r0 The minimum downtime of the compressor is set by the parameter t2; the compressor will be forced to shut down

When the compressor is powered on for the first time, if there is a delay, it will not work during the delay time until the delay ends. Battery charge and discharge control ● : the main control panel shall have a lithium battery charge and discharge control circuit. In case of any failure of the mains supply, the lithium battery starts to power the computer b

main control panel shall have a lithium battery charge and discharge control circuit. In case of any failure of the mains supply, the lithium battery starts to power the computer board, and the power ● - failure alarm is initiated to make a beeping sound . The battery is required to maintain the computer board powered for no less than 20 hours. During the normal power - on and operation of the machine, the main control panel charges and maintains the battery depending on the battery voltage to ensure the ser vice life of the battery. Starting conditions for battery charging: every time when the computer board is powered on, it will charge the battery for 5 minutes first; then, it will determine the battery voltage and start charging when the detected battery ● voltage falls between 2V and 3.8V . During the long - term operation of the machine, the computer board will restart charging whenever the battery voltage falls within this range. state, press and hold the “Freezing Defrosting” button for 5 seconds, and the freezing compressor is shut down forcibly for defrosting. After defrosting, you need to press the button again for 5 seconds in the unlocked state to restore the normal operation of the compressor. 6-2 Operating principle ① Control of condenser fan: When the compressor is turned on, the fan is turned on; When the compressor is turned off, the fan is turned off. ② Control of fan and light in refrigerator compartment: when the door switch is turned on, the light in refrigerator compartment is on, and the inner fan stops; When the door is closed, the light is off, and the inner fan is on. When the refrigeration compressor stops, it is set as L5=0, the fan stops. ③ Control of compressor: Startup conditions: control sensor temperature Tc≥ set value (Ts)+ control temperature difference (r0) Shutdown condition: control sensor temp

e fan stops. ③ Control of compressor: Startup conditions: control sensor temperature Tc≥ set value (Ts)+ control temperature difference (r0) Shutdown condition: control sensor temperature Tc≤ set value (Ts)- control temperature difference (r0) ④ Battery control: there is a battery switch on the device, which should be turned on before normal startup. As soon as AC power meeting the device requirements is connected, the device will enter the normal working state. When AC power is supplied normally, the device can charge the battery as required, and the rated voltage of the battery is 12V. When AC power failure occurs unexpectedly, the battery can supply power to the display screen to make it display normally. When the battery is discharged to ≤10.5V, the battery stops supplying power and the display screen no longer displays. To completely cut off the power, you only need to unplug the AC power cord, and then turn off the battery switch on the device to completely cut off the power, and the display screen will not display. ⑤ Control of heating wire of refrigerator compartment door: Th

n turn off the battery switch on the device to completely cut off the power, and the display screen will not display. ⑤ Control of heating wire of refrigerator compartment door: The heating wire is controlled by the mechanical thermostat in the top electric cabinet. When the temperature in the refrigerator is higher than 12℃, the thermostat is turned off and the heating wire does not work. When the temperature in the refrigerator is lower than 9±1.5℃, the thermostat is turned on and the heating wire starts to work. This function is to prevent the glass door of refrigerator from condensation. 31 31 SERVICE MANUAL Chapter 7 Control and display system 7-1 Control and display panel Control panel Buttons： A SET——Parameter setting and confirmation B Digit switch ——Used to adjust the parameter setting position C Temperature adjust——Used to adjust the parameter settings D Temperature zone switch——Used to switch between the refrigeration and freezing parameter setting E Alarm test——If the button is pressed down in the locked state, the refrigeration/freezing screen displays the fault code; if

The product is an air-circulating heating product. To ensure the temperature uniformity of the cabinet, items shall not be placed too close and shall avoid blocking the air ducts or fitting closely to the vertical plates of the air ducts. Additionally, users shall be informed of the proper method of use; 2. The product comes with 2 feet, and the model HYR-351 also comes with 2 brake casters. After installation and commissioning of the product, please tighten the feet and press on the brakes to avoid product movement, and explain to the users how to use the product. Case Preventive Measures, Product Use and Daily Maintenance 7.1 Principle of ultra-low temperature dual-system conversion frequency refrigeration: Dual-system conversion frequency ultra-low temperature storage box is composed of two same independent refrigerating systems. Each system can provide a cold storage environment for the cabinet separately as a refrigeration unit. The refrigeration mode of each system is a single -machine self -cascade refrigerating system, namely, a compressor is use

nment for the cabinet separately as a refrigeration unit. The refrigeration mode of each system is a single -machine self -cascade refrigerating system, namely, a compressor is used for compressing the refrigerant at different evaporation temperatures, and then the medium -temperature and the low -temperature refrigerant are separated by a gas -liquid separator; the medium -temperature refrigerant is allowed to cool and condense the low -temperature refrigerant in the intercooler, so that the low-temperature refrigerant reaches the liquid state and achieve the refrigeration effect after throttling. 7.2 Use method of ultra-low temperature cabinet Use method: When the ultra -low temperature cabinet is used for the first time, or the ultra -low temperature cabinet is transported, or the ultra -low temperature cabinet is powered off (including power failure) for more than 10 hours, it is necessary to test the machine before using (or before powering on and reusing). The display temperature is inconsistent with the actual test temperature of the machine: Because our display temperature is the temperature of a certain point inside the box, the temperature detected by the user is the temperature of another point inside the box, and the inconsistent position must cause different temperature, and meanwhile, there is certain error between the test tools of the users and our temperature sensing probe; B. The temperature difference between the upper and lower part of the machine box is too large: Since our machine starts to cool from top to bottom, the upper temperature is lower than the temperature below, and the temperature difference between the upper and lower parts is la rge; and the temperature difference of the similar products in the world is at 5 -8 degrees, and ours is basically within 6 degrees; in addition, the frequent opening and closing door by the user will also the big temperature difference between the upper and lower parts; C. thin 6 degrees; in addition, the frequent opening and closing door by the user will also the big temperature difference between the upper and lower parts; C. How does -86 ℃ set by user rise to -82℃? In order to guarantee the service life of the machine, our products are designed so that when the ambient temperature is higher than 35 ℃, and if the set temperature is lower than -82 ℃, the product is adjusted to -82 ℃, and if the ambient temperature is lower than 30 ℃ (inclusive), the product returns to the original set value; D. What's the reason for the fast temperature rising at the time of opening the door? Why the temperature rising of other brands is slow? (1) The temperature of the ultra -low temperature cabinet is relatively low, which has a big temperature difference with the ambient temperature, and our temperature sensing probe is more sensitive, so the temperature rises rapidly when the door is opened; (2) The other brands add the function of slow temperature rising in the design of the computer board and the temperature sensing probe, so the temperature rises slowly or the

ned; (2) The other brands add the function of slow temperature rising in the design of the computer board and the temperature sensing probe, so the temperature rises slowly or the temperature before opening door is displayed consistent for a long time when the user opens the door (for example, the product of Meiling). F. How to handle the machine displacement occurred at the time of opening the door? The machine is equipped with casters which are flexible, movable, lockable, suppo rted, and can realize fine adjustment as required; After the machine is installed to the designated position by the user, the front two casters shall be fixed to prevent the machine from moving when the door is opened. There are two cases: The first reason is that the internal and external temperature difference is large, causing the door body to be under negative pressure. Case Preventive Measures, Product Use and Daily Maintenance 7.1 Principle of ultra-low temperature frequency conversion refrigeration: The low-temperature refrigerator adopts cascade refrigeration system which is usually composed of two or more refrigeration systems, referred to as high -temperature level and low-temperature level respectively. The high temperature level uses the medium-temperature refrigerant and the low-temperature level uses the low-temperature refrigerant, each of them is a complete refrigeration system; these two part s are contacted by a condensing evaporator, so such evaporato

emperature level uses the low-temperature refrigerant, each of them is a complete refrigeration system; these two part s are contacted by a condensing evaporator, so such evaporator is a high -temperature level evaporator and also a low-temperature level condenser. The low temperature refrigerant absorbs heat of the cooled object in the evaporator of the low -temperature lev el system and transfers such heat to the refrigerant of the high temperature level system by means of a condensing evaporator, and then such heat is transferred to the cooling medium in the high -temperature level condenser by the refrigerant of the high -temperature level system. It is designed with double compressor cascade refrigeration system using the technology of variable frequency compressor, so the system is more reliable. According to the temperature requirement of the box, the rotating speed of th e compressor is automatically adjusted, to adjust the refrigerating capacity of the system. The temperature fluctuation inside the box is smaller, reaching better uniformity. In the stable operation stage, lo

y adjusted, to adjust the refrigerating capacity of the system. The temperature fluctuation inside the box is smaller, reaching better uniformity. In the stable operation stage, low -speed refrigerating capacity is used, so that the noise is lower and the power consumption is lower. After opening the door, it is automatically changed to high rotating speed to provide large refrigerating capacity, so that the temperature inside the box is quickly restored to the temperature before opening door 7.2 Use method of ultra-low temperature cabinet Use method: When the ultra -low temperature cabinet is used for the first time, or the ultra -low temperature cabinet is transported, or the ultra -low temperature cabinet is powered off (in cluding power failure) for more than 10 hours, it is necessary to test the machine before using (or before powering on and reusing). Typical Failure and Solutions, Frequently Asked Questions 12.1 Type failure and solutions A. The display temperature is inconsistent with the actual test temperature of the machine: Because our di splay temperature is the temperature of a certain point inside the box, the temperature detected by the user is the temperature of another point inside the box, and the inconsistent position must cause different temperature, and meanwhile, there is certain error between the test tools of the users and our temperature sensing probe; B. The temperature difference between the upper and lower part of the machine box is too large: Since our machine starts to cool from top to bottom, the upper temperature is l ower than the temperature below, and the temperature difference between the upper and lower parts is large; and the temperature difference of the similar products in the world is at 5 -8 degrees, and ours is basically within 6 degrees; in addition, the frequent opening and closing door by the user will also the big temperature difference between the upper and lower parts; C. How does -86 ℃

cally within 6 degrees; in addition, the frequent opening and closing door by the user will also the big temperature difference between the upper and lower parts; C. How does -86 ℃ set by user rise to -82℃? In order to guarantee the service life of the machine, our products are designed so that wh en the ambient temperature is higher than 35 ℃, and if the set temperature is lower than -82 ℃, the product is adjusted to -82 ℃, and if the ambient temperature is lower than 30 ℃ (inclusive), the product returns to the original set value; Ultra-low Temperature Frequency Conversion After-sales Service Manual 46 D. What's the reason for the fast temperature rising at the time of opening the door? Why the temperature rising of other brands is slow? (1) The temperature of the ultra -low temperature cabinet is relatively low, which has a big temperature difference with the ambien t temperature, and our temperature sens or probe is more sensitive, so the temperature rises rapidly when the door is opened; (2) The other brands add the function of slow temperature rising in the design of the comput

s or probe is more sensitive, so the temperature rises rapidly when the door is opened; (2) The other brands add the function of slow temperature rising in the design of the computer board and the temperature sensing probe, so the temperature rises slowly or the temperature before opening door is displayed consistent for a long time when the user opens the door (for example, the product of Meiling). F. What are the reasons of displaying E10 and other symbols? The main sensor fault display E10, the condenser sensor fault display E12, the ambient temperature sensor fault display E11, check whether the above wiring is normal or not, otherwise it will be repaired and replaced by after-sales service. G. How to handle the machine displacement occurred at the time of opening the door? The machine is equipped with casters which are flexible, movable, lockable, supported, and can realize fine adjustment as required; After the machine is installed to the designated position by the user, the front two casters shall be fixed to prevent the machine from moving when the door is opened. H. What's t

After the machine is installed to the designated position by the user, the front two casters shall be fixed to prevent the machine from moving when the door is opened. H. What's the matter that the low temperature cabinet door cannot be opened? There are two cases: The first reason is that the internal and external temperature difference is large, causing the door body to be under negative pressure. The processing method is: the user inserts a fine iron sheet between the door sealing strip and the door body, to make the air is fed into the line; The other reason is that there is moisture inside when the user stores the items, causing that the water flows to the sealing strip and freezes so that the door cannot be opened. The processing method is: to open the door by means of a tool. 12.2 Troubleshooting common problems Problems Cause analysis Maintenance measures 1. Precautionary measures, product use, and daily maintenance 7.1 Freezing principle The flat plate plasma quick freezer comprises Bitzer two-stage compressor, Ebm-Papst fan, etc. The high-temperature and high-pressure gas is compressed by the compressor, cooled by the condenser, and finally sent Flat Plate Plasma Quick Freezer After-Sales Service Manual 12 to the evaporator via the dryer for evaporative cooling. When refrigerating begins, the electronic expansion valve will be opene

p: HAIER SERVİS MANUELLERİ\XSD-24FL Service manual-Digital Screen.pdf
t: Plasma Quick Freezer After-Sales Service Manual 12 to the evaporator via the dryer for evaporative cooling. When refrigerating begins, the electronic expansion valve will be opened, and the defrosting valve will be closed. The opening size of the electronic expansion valve is dependent on the return air pressure and temperature, and it determines the cold plate cooling temperature together with the degree of evaporation. When the evaporation is thorough and the opening size is large, a lower refrigeration temperature can be reached. During defrosting operation, the electronic expansion valve is closed when the cold plate temperature is relatively high, while the defrosting valve keeps open to enable more thorough defrosting through the high-temperature and high-pressure gas from the compressor. 7.2 Method of use for the plasma quick freezer Please clean the upper and lower cold plates before power-on: 1) Turn on the main switch; the temperature of the upper and lower cold plates and the equipment status information can be read and displayed in real time; 2) If the digital display is

If defrosting is necessary, you will need to perform the defrosting operations; if defrosting is unnecessary, you can continue with the freezing operations. 7.3 Working principle of the oil differential pressure switch 1) Principle: Once the compressor oil differential pressure returns to the set value, the LED light of the switch goes out. The time interval between the pull-in of the two contactor coils of the compressor shall not be greater than 0.5s. 9.2 Temperature offset adjustment method In the unlocked state, when you press and hold the function selection key, the display panel will display a value. At this time, you can detect the temperature of each corresponding point with a temperature-measuring instrument. If there is any difference, you can adjust it by adjusting the Offset value. The value will be automatically stored after the adjustment. For example, the temperature displayed by a user's machine is -80℃, but the inner temperature measured by the user is -70℃; so, there is a 10℃ difference between the two values. To reduce the temperature difference between the two, the temperature offset can be adjusted to +10℃; then, the displayed temperature becomes -70℃, and the set temperature becomes consistent with the actual temperature. 9.3 Conde

If the switch senses a large pressure, the output voltage will be large, and the fan runs quickly. On the contrary, the output voltage will be small, and the speed will be slow. Case preventive measures, product use and daily maintenance knowledge 7.1 Freezing principle The flat-plate plasma freezer is composed of a BITZER two -stage compressor and an ebm -papst fan. When cooling starts, the electronic expansion valve opens and the defrost valve closes. The electronic expansion v alve controls the opening of the expansion valve according to the return air pressure and temperature. The opening and the degree of evaporation determine the cooling temperature of the cold plate. Evaporation is complete, and the temperature and cooling d epth are low when the opening is large. During the defrosting operation, the electronic expansion valve is closed when the temperature of the cold plate is relatively high, the defrosting valve is always open, and the high -temperature and high-pressure gas of the compressor is used for defrosting, thus ensuring more thorough defrosting. 7.2 How to use the plasma rapid freezer Please clean the upper and lower cold plates before enabling the rapid freezer; 1) Turn

Specific control, working principle and parameters 9.1 The temperature control system controlled by PLC controls the start and stop of the press The compressor is a three-phase 380V voltage and is controlled by an AC contactor. The AC contactor is controlled by the PLC output module signal. In order to make the compressor start smoothly, the double -coil starting method is adopted, that is, two compressor contactors are used. The time before and after the contactor coils of the two compressors are pulled in is not more than 0.5s. 9.2 Adjustment method of temperature deviation In the administrator mode, enter the parameter interface and directly change temperature deviation of the upper and lower cold plates as required. For example: The displayed temperature of a user's machine is -80° C, but the temperature inside the box measured by the user is -75° C, resulting in a difference of 5° C, in which case the temperature deviation can be adjusted to be +5° C in order to reduce the temperature difference, so that the displayed temperature then becomes -75° C, aligning the set temperature with the actual temperature. 9.3 Control of condensing fan The speed of the condensing fan is adjusted according to the return air pressure and temperature. There is a speed control switch at the outlet of the liquid storage tank. If the switch feels too high pressure, the output voltage will be large and the fan will run quickly; otherwise, the output voltage will be small and the speed will be reduced. slow.
